pages.title: Stellar Lamp
pages.text: A stellar frame casing with glowstone at its heart, so it shines with a warm, golden light like a small star seen through a window. It is warm to stand next to. The colour is the warm yellow of a midday sun, steady and comforting, and the seams of the casing glow brightest of all.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stellar frame casing glowed at its seams already. Adding glowstone dust turned it into a lamp that gives off starlight. It is my favourite light.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Focus Receiver.
